lesson.title: Strange happenings
lesson.title_ar: القسم الأدبي (10): حوادث غامضة (مثلث برمودا، لعنة توت عنخ آمون، وحلم إيريل في أبيرفان)

lines: The Bermuda Triangle is a name given to an area of the Atlantic Ocean between the islands of Bermuda and Puerto Rico and the coast of the State of Florida in the USA. It is famous because many ships and planes have disappeared there.

Perhaps the biggest mystery is the loss of five US Navy planes in 1945. At 2pm on December 5th they took off from Fort Lauderdale to fly over the Bermuda Triangle. The weather was perfect. Soon afterwards the leader of the flight sent this message on the radio: ' We are off course ... we cannot see land ... everything is wrong and strange ... the ocean doesn't look the way it should ...' And then silence. Another aircraft was sent to look for the missing planes, but it too was never seen again. In total, six planes and 27 men had disappeared.
Nobody has ever been able to explain this or any of the other disappearances. Over 150 ships and planes and more than 1,000 people have been lost in this part of the ocean.
content.caption: Map of the Bermuda Triangle between Florida, Bermuda and Puerto Rico (PB page 62)

lines: Tutankhamun was the king, or Pharaoh, of Egypt over 3,500 years ago. He died when he was only 10 years old and was buried in Luxor in southern Egypt. As was the custom in those days, his tomb, the room where his body lay, was filled with treasure and then closed in. In later years, robbers used to break into the Pharaoh's tombs to steal the treasure, but the tomb of Tutankhamun stayed hidden for centuries. Then in 1923 the British archaeologist, Carnarvon, found and broke into the tomb. Above the gold coffin of the boy king was a piece of writing, which Carnarvon translated. It read: 'Death will come to those who disturb the sleep of the 'Pharaohs.'

Two months later, Carnarvon was dead. Doctors said that he had been bitten by a mosquito. Other members of his team died of mysterious illness soon afterwards : after six years, 12 of the people who had broken into the tomb were dead. Other deaths followed. In 1972, the treasure of Tutankhamun was flown to London by plane for an exhibition. For years later, the pilot of the plane died suddenly at the age of 40. At the time his wife said: 'It's the curse of Tutankhamun - the curse that killed him.

The main industry of Aberfan, a small town in South Wales, used to be digging for coal. Coal dust and small pieces of coal could not be sold, so they were piled up in heaps, called slag heaps. They were like small, black mountains. There was a primary school in the town and, on the hill above the school, was a slag heap.

Eryl Jones went to the primary school in Aberfan. One day she told her mother about a dream. She dreamed that she had gone to school, but the school was no longer there. 'Something black had come over it,' she said. Two days later the slag heap slid down the hill and covered the school. 144 schoolchildren and teachers died.
Discussion: • Try to explain these three things.  • Can you think of any happenings like these?

blocks.edu_note_html:
ملاحظات نقل حرفي وتاريخي (PB p. 62 & WB p. 95):
1) في قصة توت عنخ آمون طُبعت عبارة For years later, the pilot of the plane died... (For خطأً مطبعياً بدل Four، وبجمع أربع سنوات إلى عام 1972 نحصل على سنة وفاة الطيار المطلوبة في WB 10 D #7: 1976).
2) طُبعت علامة تنصيص مفردة زائدة في the 'Pharaohs.' ونُقلت الصياغة الحرفية للكتاب بعمر توت عنخ آمون (10 years old، رغم أن الدراسات التاريخية الأثرية ترجّح نحو 18–19 عاماً عند وفاته — والكتاب يُدرَّس حرفياً كما هو)، وسُقطت علامة الاقتباس الختامية بعد killed him..
3) طُبع الاسم الجغرافي لبورتوريكو في القائمة وفي النص بشكل صحيح (Puerto Rico) وذُكر في تمرين البحث السريع 10 A إلى جانب USA / Egypt / Britain / Wales.

interactive_spot.label: مخطط كارثة أبيرفان (قبل الانهيار وبعده — WB 10 G) ومفتاح الأرقام

simple_explain.html:
• تفسير علمي عقلاني للحوادث الثلاث (سؤال Discussion):
    1) مثلث برمودا: منطقة واسعة مزدحمة بالملاحة والرحلات وتتسم بعواصف استوائية وتغيرات جوية سريعة وتيارات بحرية عميقة (Gulf Stream) وأخطاء ملاحية بشرية.
    2) لعنة توت عنخ آمون: موت اللورد كارنارفون ناجم عن عدوى لدغة بعوضة ملوثة، ووجود عفن وفطريات قديمة في القبور المغلقة مع كبر سن بعض أعضاء الفريق ومصادفات زمنية على مدى عقود.
    3) حلم إيريل وأبيرفان: تكديس مخلفات الفحم غير الثابتة على منحدر فوق المدرسة جعل تشبّعه بمياه الأمطار يسبب انزلاقاً أرضياً مأساوياً (تُظهر إيريل حدساً أو قلقاً متصلاً بالمنظر الخطر فوق مدرستها).

example.html: Year calculation for WB 10 D #7: 1972 (treasure flown to London) + 'For [Four] years later' = 1976 (year the pilot died).

activities.prompt_literal: ARTS 10 A Look quickly through the three texts. Find the following: 1 Four countries, 2 Four towns or cities, 3 Three people, 4 Three dates.
activities.prompt_ar: استخرج سريعاً العناصر المطلوبة بالمسح القرائي من النصوص الثلاثة (WB ص 94):

items.question: 1 Four countries
items.model_answer: USA, Egypt, Britain (and Wales / England; plus Bermuda / Puerto Rico as islands/territories named).
items.explain_ar: تظهر USA وEgypt وBritain وWales (Aberfan في جنوب ويلز).

items.question: 2 Four towns or cities
items.explain_ar: أربع مدن وبلدات بالترتيب في النصوص.

items.question: 3 Three people
items.model_answer: Tutankhamun, Carnarvon (the British archaeologist), Eryl Jones (also the pilot).
items.explain_ar: الثلاثة المسمَّون بالاسم في القصة الثانية والثالثة.

items.question: 4 Three dates
items.model_answer: 1945 (December 5th), 1923, 1972 (also over 3,500 years ago / two days later).

hints: هذه مهارة المسح البصري السريع (scanning) بحثاً عن الأسماء والأعلام والأرقام.

activities.prompt_literal: B Read 'The Bermuda Triangle'. Answer the questions. Write short answers. C Write a summary of this text from your answers to activity B.
activities.prompt_ar: أجب بإجابات قصيرة عن مثلث برمودا (10 B) ثم ادمجها في فقرة تلخيصية (10 C — WB ص 94):

items.question: 1 What is the Bermuda Triangle?
items.model_answer: An area of the Atlantic Ocean between Bermuda, Puerto Rico and the coast of Florida in the USA.

items.question: 2 Why is it famous?
items.model_answer: Because many ships and planes have disappeared there.

items.question: 3 What is the biggest mystery?
items.model_answer: The loss of five US Navy planes (plus the search aircraft — 6 planes and 27 men).

items.question: 5 Why is it a mystery?
items.model_answer: Because the weather was perfect, the leader radioed that everything looked wrong/strange before silence fell, a rescue aircraft vanished too, and nobody has ever explained why.

items.question: 6 What else has happened in the area?
items.model_answer: Over 150 ships and planes and more than 1,000 people have been lost there.

items.question: 10 C Model Summary (combining answers 1–6):
items.model_answer: The Bermuda Triangle is an area of the Atlantic Ocean between Bermuda, Puerto Rico and Florida, famous because many ships and planes have vanished there. Its biggest mystery happened at 2 pm on December 5th, 1945, when five US Navy planes and a search aircraft disappeared with 27 men despite perfect weather and a strange final radio message. Altogether, over 150 ships and planes and more than 1,000 people have disappeared in the area without explanation.
items.explain_ar: ملخص متماسك مستند حرفياً إلى أجوبة 10 B.

hints: اربط إجابات 1–6 بأدوات العطف لتكوين ملخص 10 C في أربع جمل واضحة.

activities.prompt_literal: D Read 'The curse of Tutankhamun'. Answer each of these questions with a number. (1 When was Tutankhamun king of Egypt? 3,500 years ago.)
activities.prompt_ar: أجب برقمٍ دقيق عن كل سؤال من 2–7 حول لعنة توت عنخ آمون (WB ص 95):

items.prompt: 2 How old was he when he died? ______ (years old)
3 When did Carnarvon break into his tomb? ______
4 How many months later did Carnarvon die? ______ (months)
5 How many members of Carnarvon's team died in the next six years? ______
6 When was the treasure flown to London? ______
7 In which year did the pilot of the plane die? ______

hints: سؤال 7 يحسب من 1972 + أربع سنوات ('For [Four] years later' في نص الكتاب ص 62) = 1976.

activities.prompt_literal: F Read 'Eryl's dream'. Find words that mean the following:
activities.prompt_ar: استخرج الكلمات الأربع من قصة حلم إيريل (WB ص 95):

items.prompt: 1 small pieces of coal and coal dust ______

hints: slag heap = كومة نفايات الفحم؛ heap = كومة (pile)؛ primary = ابتدائي/أوّلي (first)؛ slid / come over = انزلق / غطّى وانطبق على المدرسة.

questions.stem: In WB Arts 10 D #7, using PB page 62 ('In 1972, the treasure... For [Four] years later, the pilot... died'), in which year did the pilot die?

options.why_wrong: 1972 هي سنة نقل الكنز بالطائرة إلى لندن (بند 6).
1945 هي سنة اختفاء الطائرات الأمريكية في مثلث برمودا.

hints: كلمة For في المطبوع تحريف مطبعي عن العدد Four، فأضف 4 إلى 1972.
questions.explain: سافر الكنز عام 1972، وتوفي الطيار بعد أربع سنوات (Four years later رغم طبعها For) أي سنة 1976.

questions.stem: In Eryl's dream (PB p. 62 / WB 10 F), what does the word 'heap' mean?

options.text: A pile (e.g. coal dust and small pieces piled up into a slag heap).

options.why_wrong: المدرسة هي ما كان أسفل التل، والكلمة الدالة على الأولية هي primary.
تخص قصة موت كارنارفون في نص توت عنخ آمون.

hints: اقرأ: piled up in heaps, called slag heaps.
questions.explain: الكلمة heap معناها كومة متجمعة (a pile).
